006package dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic;
007
008import java.time.OffsetTime;
009import java.time.ZonedDateTime;
010
011import dev.metaschema.core.datatype.adapter.MetaschemaDataTypeProvider;
012import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.InvalidValueForCastFunctionException;
013import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.impl.TimeWithTimeZoneItemImpl;
014import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.type.IAtomicOrUnionType;
015import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.type.InvalidTypeMetapathException;
016import dev.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
017import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
018
019/**
020 * An atomic Metapath item representing a time value in the Metapath system with
021 * an explicit time zone.
022 * <p>
023 * This interface provides functionality for handling time values with time zone
024 * information, supporting parsing, casting, and comparison operations. It works
025 * in conjunction with {@link ZonedDateTime} to eliminate time zone ambiguity.
026 */
027public interface ITimeWithTimeZoneItem extends ITimeItem {
028  /**
029   * Get the type information for this item.
030   *
031   * @return the type information
032   */
033  @NonNull
034  static IAtomicOrUnionType<ITimeWithTimeZoneItem> type() {
035    return MetaschemaDataTypeProvider.TIME_WITH_TZ.getItemType();
036  }
037
038  @Override
039  default IAtomicOrUnionType<ITimeWithTimeZoneItem> getType() {
040    return type();
041  }
042
043  /**
044   * Construct a new time item using the provided string {@code value}.
045   *
046   * @param value
047   *          a string representing a time
048   * @return the new item
049   */
050  @NonNull
051  static ITimeWithTimeZoneItem valueOf(@NonNull String value) {
052    try {
053      return valueOf(MetaschemaDataTypeProvider.TIME_WITH_TZ.parse(value));
054    } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {
055      throw new InvalidTypeMetapathException(
056          null,
057          String.format("Invalid time value '%s'. %s",
058              value,
059              ex.getLocalizedMessage()),
060          ex);
061    }
062  }
063
064  /**
065   * Construct a new time item using the provided {@code value}.
066   * <p>
067   * This method handles dates with explicit timezone information using
068   * ZonedDateTime. The timezone is preserved as specified in the input and is
069   * significant for time operations and comparisons.
070   *
071   * @param value
072   *          a time, with time zone information
073   * @return the new item
074   */
075  @NonNull
076  static ITimeWithTimeZoneItem valueOf(@NonNull ZonedDateTime value) {
077    return new TimeWithTimeZoneItemImpl(ObjectUtils.notNull(value.toOffsetDateTime().toOffsetTime()));
078  }
079
080  /**
081   * Construct a new time item using the provided {@code value}.
082   * <p>
083   * This method handles dates with explicit timezone information using
084   * ZonedDateTime. The timezone is preserved as specified in the input and is
085   * significant for time operations and comparisons.
086   *
087   * @param value
088   *          a time, with time zone information
089   * @return the new item
090   */
091  @NonNull
092  static ITimeWithTimeZoneItem valueOf(@NonNull OffsetTime value) {
093    return new TimeWithTimeZoneItemImpl(value);
094  }
095
096  /**
097   * Cast the provided type to this item type.
098   *
099   * @param item
100   *          the item to cast
101   * @return the original item if it is already this type, otherwise a new item
102   *         cast to this type
103   * @throws InvalidValueForCastFunctionException
104   *           if the provided {@code item} cannot be cast to this type
105   */
106  @NonNull
107  static ITimeWithTimeZoneItem cast(@NonNull IAnyAtomicItem item) {
108    ITimeWithTimeZoneItem retval;
109    if (item instanceof ITimeWithTimeZoneItem) {
110      retval = (ITimeWithTimeZoneItem) item;
111    } else if (item instanceof ITemporalItem) {
112      retval = fromTemporal((ITemporalItem) item);
113    } else if (item instanceof IStringItem || item instanceof IUntypedAtomicItem) {
114      try {
115        retval = valueOf(item.asString());
116      } catch (IllegalStateException | InvalidTypeMetapathException ex) {
117        // asString can throw IllegalStateException exception
118        throw new InvalidValueForCastFunctionException(ex);
119      }
120    } else {
121      throw new InvalidValueForCastFunctionException(
122          String.format("unsupported item type '%s'", item.getClass().getName()));
123    }
124    return retval;
125  }
126
127  @NonNull
128  private static ITimeWithTimeZoneItem fromTemporal(@NonNull ITemporalItem temporal) {
129    if (!temporal.hasTimezone()) {
130      // asString can throw IllegalStateException exception
131      throw new InvalidValueForCastFunctionException(
132          String.format("Unable to cast the temporal value '%s', since it lacks timezone information.",
133              temporal.asString()));
134    }
135    if (!temporal.hasTime()) {
136      // asString can throw IllegalStateException exception
137      throw new InvalidValueForCastFunctionException(
138          String.format("Unable to cast the temporal value '%s', since it lacks date information.",
139              temporal.asString()));
140    }
141    // get the time
142    return new TimeWithTimeZoneItemImpl(ObjectUtils.notNull(OffsetTime.of(
143        temporal.getHour(),
144        temporal.getMinute(),
145        temporal.getSecond(),
146        temporal.getNano(),
147        temporal.getZoneOffset())));
148  }
149
150  @Override
151  default ITimeWithTimeZoneItem castAsType(IAnyAtomicItem item) {
152    return cast(item);
153  }
154}
